lemma covers (H : C.Makes) (hx : Injective x) : (cover x Z D hz hd).Works h v x f := by
  have hh : Injective (flipCover x) := (Signed.act_injective _).comp hx
  constructor
  · intro q t i
    have ha := placed_free Z hz q
    have hb := placed_free D hd q
    unfold Extraction.Order.late at *
    filter_upwards [ha,hb] with k hk hk'
    filter_upwards [hk,hk'] with j hj hj'
    dsimp only [cover,flashPlot]
    exact ⟨Complex.continuous_re.measurable.comp (((hj _).1.subC (hj' _).1).meas), fun U =>
      (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans ((norm_sub_le ..).trans (add_le_add ((hj _).2 U).2 ((hj' _).2 U).2))⟩

proof_context.conclusion: `covers` shows measurability and the bound `|plot| <= reserve` only along `f.late` (eventually in the ordered limits), with injectivity of `x` and of `flipCover x` as hypotheses.

lemma real_pair {x : ι → Cover} {y : κ → Cover} (hx : Injective x) (hy : Injective y)
    (i j : ℕ) (hij : i<j) : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, Injective (Sum.elim (offset x t i) (offset y t j)) := by
  have he (a : ι) (b : κ) : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, offset x t i a ≠ offset y t j b := by
    let n : ℤ := x a timeAxis - y b timeAxis
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop n.natAbs] with t ht e
    have hu : 0 ≤ (t:ℤ) := by omega
    have hv : (i:ℤ)+1 ≤ (j:ℤ) := by omega
    have hm : n < (t:ℤ) := by omega
    have hh := congr_fun e timeAxis
    change x a timeAxis + (t:ℤ)*i=y b timeAxis+(t:ℤ)*j at hh
    unfold n at hm
    linarith only [hm,hh,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv hu]
  filter_upwards [eventually_all.mpr fun a => eventually_all.mpr (he a)] with t hh
  rintro (a|a) (b|b) h
  · exact congr_arg Sum.inl (hx (add_right_cancel h))
  · exact (hh a b h).elim
  · exact (hh b a h.symm).elim
  exact congr_arg Sum.inr (hy (add_right_cancel h))

proof_context.conclusion: `real_pair` shows that for `i < j` and `t` large the joint list `offset x t i` with `offset y t j` is injective, because the time coordinates differ by `t*(j-i)` plus a fixed difference.
